# Third-party code bundled in this extension

Browser extensions may not load code from the internet, so these are included as files.

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docx.umd.js` | [docx](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx) | 8.5.0 | MIT |
| `html2pdf.bundle.min.js` | [html2pdf.js](https://github.com/eKoopmans/html2pdf.js) (includes jsPDF and html2canvas) | 0.10.1 | MIT |

Both are used only on the report page, to export the report as a Word or PDF file inside your browser.
